title: datacebo-cookbook
summary: A collection of Jupyter notebook tutorials and guides published to DataCebo's cookbook site, demonstrating practical SDV workflows such as handling null values, ID column generation, and multi-table synthesis. The notebooks directly run SDV's single-table and multi-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, HMA) along with rdt transformers and sdmetrics/evaluation utilities.
needs: This repository is owned by the datacebo GitHub organization and is explicitly a first-party SDV tutorial/cookbook site; likely warrants first-party status (importance 6) which is outside the scale available here.
